scope: Six high-priority draft questions: answer and guideline scope checked against public authoritative guideline pages; no changes to their verified statuses.
limitations: AI-assisted textual cross-check is not a credentialed clinical review or attestation.
Guideline dates and scope must be confirmed against current full text and applicable Japanese regulatory/institutional guidance before approval.
No question is promoted to status verified; actual clinician/source-review sign-off is still required.

items.source_locator: Consensus Statement 2: Follow-up Blood Cultures, adult remarks; Consensus Statement 1: Risk Stratification
items.target_population: Adults with S. aureus bloodstream infection
items.caution: FUBC positive at ≥48 h triggers more diagnostic workup and source-control reassessment. Antibiotic susceptibility, dose, and antimicrobial choice should be reviewed separately; the linked consensus has stated that future manuscripts will cover MSSA/MRSA drug selection.
items.pending_clinician_review: Confirm wording for adult patients, interpretation of positive cultures at ≥48 h and actual need for source control.

items.source_locator: Consensus Statement 2: Follow-up Blood Cultures; duration remarks
items.target_population: Adults with S. aureus bloodstream infection
items.caution: Consensus suggests ≥2 sets of follow-up cultures at 48h and then every 24–48h until negative; bacteremia treatment duration is generally counted from culture clearance, with source-control caveat.
items.pending_clinician_review: Check that model answer distinguishes bacteremia clearance from other duration determinants; confirm pediatric differences if used.

items.source_name: IDSA Clinical Practice Guideline for Candidiasis (2016)
items.target_population: Patients with candidemia (nonneutropenic section; guidance also addresses neutropenic hosts separately)
items.caution: Recommendation 11 advises blood cultures every day or every other day until clearance is established. This is a 2016 guideline; verify whether newer relevant domestic or international guidance changes recommendations.
items.pending_clinician_review: Confirm whether the question should explicitly identify nonneutropenic candidemia and cite the recommendation number.

items.source_name: IDSA Clinical Practice Guideline for Candidiasis (2016)
items.caution: A complete teaching answer must explicitly state ≥2 weeks after documented blood culture clearance AND resolution of attributable symptoms, assuming no metastatic complications. Existing choice names both factors but omits the 2-week minimum, so retain draft until teaching answer is improved and signed off.
items.pending_clinician_review: Consider revising explanation/answer to state the ≥14-day condition without suggesting that all candidemia can be treated this way.

items.source_locator: Executive Summary: AUC/MIC monitoring recommendations for serious MRSA infections
items.target_population: Serious/invasive MRSA infections, assuming MIC by broth microdilution of 1 mg/L
items.caution: AUC24 400–600 mg·h/L is an exposure target for serious MRSA infections with stated MIC assumption; do not extrapolate mechanically to all pathogens, uncomplicated infections, or unstable renal function without separate consideration.
items.pending_clinician_review: Check units, chosen dosing model/monitoring tool and Japanese context; avoid implying sole reliance on trough concentrations.

items.source_name: IDSA Clinical Practice Guideline for Complicated UTI (2025)
items.source_locator: Recommendations on the Timing of Intravenous to Oral Antibiotics Transition, Recommendation I
items.target_population: Patients with complicated UTI, including pyelonephritis, initially treated parenterally who are improving and can take oral therapy
items.caution: Recommendation is conditional, low-certainty evidence; requires clinical improvement, ability to take oral antibiotics, and availability of an effective oral agent. Source control and relevant exclusions should be evaluated before using it as a universal rule.
items.pending_clinician_review: Confirm inclusion/exclusion criteria from full guidance, severity, bacteremia, obstruction and available oral alternatives.
